title_en: Numbers & Survival — shop, order, find your way
subtitle: Count to ten, then the whole system opens
description: Chinese numbers are a machine you learn once: count 1–10 and every price, time and phone number unlocks. Plus ordering, bargaining and finding the toilet — English + ខ្មែរ support, native audio on every line.

spine.title: The route · one afternoon out
spine.note: Learn 1–10 → build any number → ask a price → order a coffee → find the toilet. A whole afternoon outside, in ten lines.

explain.title: The big picture
explain.why: After ten, Chinese numbers are pure Lego: 11 is 'ten-one', 20 is 'two-ten', 123 is 'one-hundred-two-ten-three'. No new words ever — just slots you already know.

tiles.ko: 一二三四五六七八九十
tiles.en: Ten sounds, that's the whole alphabet of numbers
Two before things is liǎng, not èr

cards.alt: Ten tiles with the characters one through ten
cards.hook: 一二三四五六七八九十
cards.ko: 一 yī 二 èr 三 sān 四 sì 五 wǔ 六 liù 七 qī 八 bā 九 jiǔ 十 shí。
cards.en: One to ten. Tap Listen and repeat each in your head — the tones are the workout.
cards.km: មួយ ពីរ បី បួន ប្រាំ ប្រាំមួយ ប្រាំពីរ ប្រាំបី ប្តាំ ដប់ — សូរ គឺ ការ ហាត់។

cards.ko: 十一 shíyī = 11，二十 èrshí = 20，一百 yìbǎi = 100。
cards.en: 11 is 'ten-one', 20 is 'two-ten', 100 is 'one-hundred'. The machine never stops.

cards.alt: A hand showing two fingers with the character 两
cards.ko: 数东西用“两”：两个人 liǎng ge rén，不說二个人。
cards.en: Before counted things use 两 (liǎng): 'two people' is 两个人. 二 is for counting and math.
cards.km: មុន នាម ពាក្យ ប្រើ liǎng៖ មនុស្ស ពីរ នាក់។

cards.alt: A price tag with a yuan sign and a question mark
cards.en: How much is this? — the two magic words of every market in China.
cards.km: តើ នេះ ថ្លៃ ប៉ុន្មាន?

cards.alt: A coin and a banknote with the character 块
cards.ko: 八十块 bāshí kuài = ¥80。“块”是口语的“元”。
cards.en: Eighty kuài = ¥80. Spoken Chinese says 块 where prices print 元.
cards.km: យួន ប៉ុន = ៨០ យួន។

cards.alt: A coffee cup with an arrow from the words 我要
cards.ko: 我要一杯咖啡。Wǒ yào yì bēi kāfēi.
cards.en: I'd like one cup of coffee. Swap in anything: 我要茶, 我要水.
cards.km: ខ្ញុំ ចង់ បាន កាហ្វេ មួយ កែវ។

cards.alt: A door with a WC sign and a question mark
cards.ko: 请问，洗手间在哪儿？Qǐng wèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?
cards.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet? 在 = at, 哪儿 = where.
cards.km: សុំ ទោស បន្ទប់ ទឹក នៅ ឯណា?

cards.alt: A phone screen showing digits grouped in threes
cards.ko: 电话号码一个数字一个数字读：138，0201。
cards.en: Phone numbers are read digit by digit — just the ten sounds you already know.
cards.km: លេខ ទូរស័ព្ទ អាន ម្តង មួយ លេខ។

qa_note: Recall the answer in your head first, then tap to check and listen.

items.qen: I keep confusing shí (10) and sì (4). Help?
items.a: 十是第二声，往上走；四是第四声，往下砸。用手画音高。
items.aen: 十 rises (tone 2), 四 falls hard (tone 4). Draw the pitch in the air with your hand while listening.
items.akm: ដប់ សូរ ឡើង លើ · បួន សូរ ចុះ ក្រោម។
items.why: They differ only by tone, so drill them as a minimal pair — ten times listening beats ten rules.

items.q: 什么时候用“两”，什么时候用“二”？
items.qen: When 两 and when 二?
items.a: 东西前用两：两个人、两杯。数数和电话号码用二。
items.aen: 两 before counted things (两个人, 两杯); 二 for counting sequences and phone numbers.
items.akm: liǎng ដាក់ មុន នាម (ពីរ នាក់) · èr សម្រាប់ នាប់ និង លេខ ទូរស័ព្ទ។

items.qen: Do people say kuài or yuán for prices?
items.a: 口语说块，菜单写元。意思一样：一百块 = 100 元。
items.aen: Spoken: 块. Printed menus: 元. Same money — 一百块 = ¥100.
items.akm: និយាយ ប្រើ kuài · សរសេរ ប្រើ yuán។ តម្លៃ ដូចគ្នា។

items.aen: Too expensive! A little cheaper, OK? (markets: always ask once, smiling)
items.akm: ថ្លៃ ពេក! សូម បញ្ចុះ តម្លៃ បន្តិច បាន ទេ?

items.aen: Two, please. (number + 个 + nothing — the default measure word)
items.akm: យក ពីរ យ៉ាង អរគុណ។

items.a: 现在三点。三点一刻 / 三点半。
items.aen: It's three. 三点一刻 = 3:15, 三点半 = 3:30.

items.km: ថ្លៃ ពេក។
ឆ្ងាញ់ ណាស់!
ខ្ញុំ មិន យល់ ទេ។

items.qen: Pattern: Number + measure word + noun — three people.
items.a: 两杯水、三个人、四个苹果。
items.aen: Two cups of water, three people, four apples. 个 works when you're unsure.
items.akm: ទឹក ពីរ កែវ · មនុស្ស បី នាក់។

items.qen: Pattern: time words are just numbers — 点 o'clock, 半 half.
items.aen: Class at 8, lunch at 12. No verb needed.
items.akm: ចូល រៀន ម៉ោង ប្រាំបី (8)។ ញ៉ាំ អាហារ ម៉ោង ដប់ពីរ (12)។

items.a: 厕所在哪儿？地铁站在哪儿？
items.aen: Where's the toilet? Where's the metro station?
items.akm: បន្ទប់ ទឹក នៅ ឯណា? ស្ថានីយ រថភ្លើង ក្រោម ដី នៅ ឯណា?

items.km: ពីរ (មុន នាម)
ថ្លៃ ប៉ុន្មាន?
បន្ទប់ ទឹក

items.ko: 这儿 / 那儿 zhèr / nàr
